chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Hammad from Hariz from Zurara from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding a person in ihram who killed a locust, he said: He gives a date, and a date is better than a locust.

key_terms.مُحْرِمٍ: A person in the state of ihram (ritual consecration for Hajj or Umrah)

ai.seo_question: What is the compensation for killing a locust while in ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfabar establishes the fidya for killing a locust while in ihram as a single date, reflecting the principle of proportional compensation based on the creature's value. Scholarly tradition notes that while some jurists debate whether the compensation should be in kind or monetary equivalent, this narration emphasizes the intrinsic worth of the date as a standard measure for small game. It highlights the practical ease of fulfilling this obligation during pilgrimage, ensuring the sanctity of the sacred state is maintained without undue burden.
